Official Studio Legal Notice

Privacy Policy

Effective Date: October 2026 • Studio: Art by Akshatha

Art by Akshatha is a solo art studio owned and operated by artist Akshatha Gopalkar. This Privacy Policy informs collectors and app visitors regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of personal information when using our Android App and online gallery studio.

1. Information We Collect

We only collect information necessary to fulfill original painting orders and studio commission requests:

  • Delivery Information: Full legal name, delivery street address, city, state, postal PIN code, and phone/WhatsApp number for insured courier dispatch across India.
  • Communication: Email address for order confirmation receipts and tracking updates.
  • Custom Commission Inquiries: Dimensions, style choices, and custom color preferences submitted through our bespoke inquiry builder.

2. Payment & Financial Data

We do not collect, store, or process credit card numbers or banking passwords on our servers.

Direct payments are completed securely via your own UPI apps (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM) to our verified UPI ID (akshatha.art@okhdfcbank) or via cash on studio pickup. We only receive the Transaction Reference ID (UTR) to match your transfer with your artwork reservation.

3. Device Storage & Local Preferences

The app uses local device storage (IndexedDB / LocalStorage) to keep track of your favorites wishlist, bag selections, and wall simulator preferences locally on your device for quick loading. No tracking cookies are sold to third parties.

4. Sharing of Information

Your personal information is never sold, traded, or rented to any advertising network. We only share shipping addresses with insured domestic courier partners (e.g. India Post, BlueDart, DTDC) strictly for physical delivery of your artwork parcel.

5. Data Retention & Your Rights

You have the right to request access to or deletion of your order contact details at any time by messaging the artist directly at akshatha.art@gmail.com or via WhatsApp at +91 98765 43210.

6. Contact the Artist

If you have any questions or feedback regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact:
